classification: pending-syn-registry-import; not an activated semantic release

types.name: Potbot research record
types.definition: A bounded, scoped Potbot investigation record; content does not grant execution authority.

types.name: Potbot research action
types.definition: An immutable research query bound to one information-need revision and execution limits.

types.name: Potbot research observation
types.definition: Observed source bytes or a classified non-result, with revision, digest and inspection status.

types.name: Potbot example adaptation
types.definition: Explicit separation of an inspected external example from the new local implementation and its checks.

types.name: Research observation batch
types.definition: A bounded result set retaining each inspected source observation and its source revision; does not establish completion of a need.

types.name: Repository snapshot inspection Cog
types.definition: Transforms a typed research action into a source observation batch against a controller-pinned repository snapshot.
